text:
START HERE: ~/Desktop/NEONDASH-README-2026-11-09.txt (to-do list + where everything stands).
Testers already checked Nov 7: 15/15 joined on Testers Community.
1) Phone test v6 (~20 min): Desktop/NeonDash-PHONE-TEST-CHECKLIST-v6.txt (Drive > NeonDash). Includes the free test gem purchase.
2) Paste the REPORT BACK section to Claude Code.
3) Check Play Console > Neon Dash > Dashboard: Google's opt-in count should be 12+.

Monday kickoff: START at the handoff README.
Open ~/Desktop/NEONDASH-README-2026-11-09.txt (Mousepad) and work its to-do list top-down.
New Claude Code session? Paste: Resume Neon Dash from ~/Desktop/NEONDASH-README-2026-11-09.txt
Today: confirm Google's opt-in count (12+) if not done; v6 phone test if not done. Tomorrow 9:00: bank deposit check.

Verify Google's test deposit (checking acct ending 611).
Play Console > Payments profile > Manage payment methods > Verify > exact amount. You type it, not Claude.

14-day tester mark (Google needs 12+ opted in 14 days straight).
1) Tell Claude Code: "check testers".
2) An auto-draft of the production answers is being made now from the tester emails; it arrives here next. Review it, then tell Claude Code: "pull the production draft".

APPLY FOR PRODUCTION today (once Testers Community's 2 reports are in).
Checklist at the top of Desktop/NeonDash-PRODUCTION-APPLICATION-DRAFT.txt. Play Console > Dashboard > Apply for production. Press Next on every section, never Discard. Or ask Claude Code for a Claude Desktop handoff that stops before Apply.

Production review should be back (usually 7 days or less). Check the Play account email / Play Console Dashboard.
Approved -> tell Claude Code "production approved".
More testing needed -> keep the closed test running, tell Claude Code, contact Testers Community about the refund guarantee.
Heads-up: Play trader status must be declared by Feb 1 (scheduled for Jan 15). Handoff: Desktop/CLAUDE-DESKTOP-PLAY-TRADER-STATUS.txt.

Declare Play trader status today (deadline Feb 1, or Google removes the app worldwide).
Play Console notice > Declare status. Likely TRADER. Use the F Street business address, never home; email neondash@gridlas.com.
Handoff: Desktop/CLAUDE-DESKTOP-PLAY-TRADER-STATUS.txt, or tell Claude Code: "walk me through trader status".
FINAL WARNING if not done yet: Play trader status deadline is Feb 1. Ignore if you already declared it.
